title: Vladimir Putin, a president sealed off in a Russia under lockdown
subhead: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites. Within society, they have spread an atmosphere of fear and suspicion that prohibits any questioning of the Kremlin or its war in Ukraine.

title: Understanding El Niño and why its weather disruption could break records this year
subhead: The El Niño climate anomaly, which occurs in the Pacific every two to seven years, triggers droughts and floods, disrupts entire sectors of the economy, and raises global temperatures.

title: In Beijing's parks, a generation still sings Mao's praises
subhead: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (4/7). Retirees who witnessed the Cultural Revolution and the Great Leap Forward meet in parks. Through their songs, they bring an era back to life, even though most prefer not to pass on those painful experiences to their descendants.
